title: Pointer to the properties of the pro-etale operations
text:
In the notation of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], the following holds.
For finite constant coefficients the structure map $u^{-1}R_V\to R_U$ and the
exactness of the module inverse image are the subject of
[prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map] and
[prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-exact].
